proposal.title: Investigating Copying Fidelity and Heredity Thresholds in Prebiotic Systems
proposal.summary: This research advances the understanding of the transition from simple non-equilibrium persistence to heritable evolutionary systems in prebiotic chemistry. By synthesizing algebraic characterizations of autocatalytic subnetworks and thermodynamic models of selection, the revision formalizes the distinction between persistent states and information-carrying templates. Findings suggest that while stoichiometric network stability enables history-dependent memory, the transition to open-ended evolution requires additional copying fidelity thresholds, supported by error-correction mechanisms.
